Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the 0x2711 IOCTL in the webvrpcs process. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this functionality to execute code under the context of Administrator. Advantech has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Advantech WebAccess webvrpcs Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
